gbm_population_evidence.quote: Neuro-oncology Multi-Disciplinary Team (MDT) decision that the imaging shows a primary GB tumour which is maximally resectable

candidate_evidence.quote: Additional DTI scan during routine pre-operative tumour MRI scan, additional use of intraoperative ultrasound in addition to normal to standard of care (Neuronavigation and intraoperative 5-ALA)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patient is suitable for concomitant adjuvant radiotherapy and Temozolomide (TMZ) chemotherapy or adjuvant TMZ at the time of MDT decision

role_evidence.quote: The comparator is standard care as per current NICE guidelines (i.e. neuronavigation based on preoperative MRI and intraoperative use of 5-ALA).

coder_notes: Surgical imaging trial (DTI + intraoperative ultrasound) with phase NA; no therapeutic drug. 5-ALA is standard fluorescence-guided resection in both arms (diagnostic_agent). Temozolomide/radiotherapy mentioned only as suitability for later adjuvant therapy, not a trial intervention; not listed. Treatment setting newly diagnosed (primary GB; recurrent GB excluded). Control arm is a registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR, so control_arm_from_other_arms = no.
